entities.summary: Giuseppe Lorenzoni was an Italian astronomer who identified helium on the sun using spectroscopy, independently of others like Charles Augustus Young. He served as a director of the Padua Observatory from 1878 until his death and served as a professor of astronomy at the University of Padua from 1872.
